reporting-org.narrative: The Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria

title.narrative: Intensified Malaria Control Program in Kalimantan, Sulawesi, Sumatra and Six Provinces of Eastern Indonesia - Indonesia (01-Apr-2016-31-Dec-2017)

description.narrative: Indonesia, Malaria, Directorate General of Disease Prevention and Control, Ministry of Health of The Republic of Indonesia (MOH)This program has the following goals: To reduce morbidity and mortality associated with malaria by reducing malaria transmission to the lowest possible level with epidemiologically appropriate interventions. The objectives of this program are: Expand access to early, confirmed diagnosis (microscopy/RDTs) and prompt treatment with ACT among high risk population including children under 5 and pregnant women. Improve routine malaria surveillance and reporting for improved management including epidemic investigation and control so that investigation of reported epidemics is routinely initiated within 24 hpurs and more tham 90% heath facilities report on time. Scale up coverage and use of LLINs among high risk population. Scale up coverage and use of LLINs among pregnant women and of children under 5.. Strengthen and improve malaria program management at central, provincial and district level. Through advocay, increase support for malaria control at community, district, provincial and nationla level so that district and provincial contribution to malaria control are increased by the end of the grant period
